packages.name: cache
packages.description: Caching for services: immutable LRU and TTL caches with stats, a shared SQLite cache with single-flight, and HTTP caching (ETags, conditional requests, Cache-Control)

packages.name: dates
packages.description: Calendar helpers on Time and Zone: boundaries, business days, ISO weeks, ranges, intervals, periods, RFC 2822, HTTP-date and ISO durations

packages.name: featureflags
packages.description: Feature flags: targeting rules, segments, prerequisites, stable percentage rollouts, OpenFeature-style details, JSON definitions and a SQLite store with audit

packages.name: health
packages.description: Liveness, readiness and startup endpoints with concurrent checks (SQLite, HTTP dependencies, files) in the application/health+json format

packages.name: humanize
packages.description: Human-readable numbers and times: byte sizes, durations, relative times, ordinals, plurals, lists, compact numbers, number words, Roman numerals, fractions

packages.name: ids
packages.description: Identifiers and encodings: ULID, KSUID, nanoid, Snowflake, UUID v4/v7 from bytes, base58, base62, base36, base32 and Crockford

packages.name: jobs
packages.description: Durable background jobs on SQLite: priorities, delays, unique keys, leases, retries with backoff, dead letters, workers and cron schedules

packages.name: jwt
packages.description: JSON Web Tokens and JWS: HS256, HS384, HS512 and EdDSA, strict parsing, claim validation with leeway, typed keys bound to one algorithm, and JWKS

packages.name: lists
packages.description: List utilities beyond the builtins: windows, splits, grouping, zips, set operations, combinatorics, searching and safe index edits

packages.name: maps
packages.description: Map utilities (merge with resolvers, invert, filter and map keys and values, counters, multimaps, diffs) and dynamic JSON values with paths, pointers and merge patches

packages.name: middleware
packages.description: Composable HTTP handler wrappers: CORS, security headers and CSP, request ids, access logs, limits, deadlines, negotiation, auth and host checks

packages.name: numeric
packages.description: Number theory, exact rounding modes, primes, combinatorics and statistics for Int, F64 and BigInt, pure and tested in both tiers

packages.name: pagination
packages.description: Offset, page-number and keyset pagination: clamped requests, signed cursors, page ranges for UIs, Link headers and JSON envelopes

packages.name: passwords
packages.description: Password policy after NIST SP 800-63B, and Argon2id hashing

packages.name: ratelimit
packages.description: Rate limiting for HTTP services: token bucket, GCRA, fixed and sliding windows, a lock-free in-memory table, a SQLite store, RateLimit headers and a handler wrapper

packages.name: retry
packages.description: Retries with exponential backoff and jitter, retry budgets, a circuit breaker and rate limiters, on a clock effect that tests run virtually

packages.name: router
packages.description: Path routing beyond svc: typed and wildcard parameters, most-specific matching, 404/405/OPTIONS, path cleaning, trailing slashes, groups, hosts, mounting and reverse URLs

packages.name: semver
packages.description: Semantic Versioning 2.0.0: parse, compare, sort and bump versions, and match Cargo and npm version ranges

packages.name: sessions
packages.description: Session tokens stored as SHA-256 digests, secure cookies and CSRF tokens for HTTP services

packages.name: sqlkit
packages.description: SQLite helpers over db: a parameters-only query builder, keyset pagination, upserts, batched inserts, up/down migrations with checksums, test fixtures

packages.name: strings
packages.description: String utilities in the spirit of Apache Commons StringUtils: case, padding, graphemes, distances, wrapping, slugs, escaping

packages.name: validate
packages.description: Validators that say why: email, URL, UUID, dates, IPv4/IPv6 and CIDR, host names, cards, IBAN, ISBN, semver, JSON and more

packages.name: webhooks
packages.description: Verify and sign webhooks: GitHub, Stripe, Slack, Standard Webhooks, Shopify and custom HMAC schemes, with timestamp tolerance and replay protection
